items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: under Papa's leadership and after Papa passed

ctx.x: When did you start with Celestan?

Oh I started playing with Celestan, I've been with the band now about ten years. Around nineteen, nineteen fifty. With the band ten years. Little better ten years now. And uh, well I mean after, well I joined the band, well before I got in the band, Harrison Verrett was in the band. Yeah. And I worked in Harrison Verrett Police a while, then Harrison Verrett came back in the band and that's Harrison went back again. Well I joined the band back again. I've been with the band ever since. Yeah. And uh, under Papa's…
You usually travel in that big bus, I used to see that bus. Yeah.
